_readme: Copy this file to .ui-workspace/figma_config.json and fill in <...> placeholders. Then run /init-ui-workspace to auto-scan project_sources and validate.
_html_hint: true = pipeline generates preview.html (iPhone mockup) so you can review before coding. false = PNG only.

color._hint: Dart files that declare your color constants. /init-ui-workspace auto-scans and fills this.

font._hint: font_family must match the family name declared under flutter > fonts in pubspec.yaml
